sources.title: Study of dynamical dark energy using DESI DR2 BAO, CMB, and Type Ia Supernovae data
sources.note: Current v1, submitted 2026-09-01; phenomenological CPL/BA/EXP/LOG/JBP comparison on overlapping public BAO/CMB/SN data. Retained to audit physical realization, parameter boundaries and dataset/sample sensitivity; parameterized w(a) preference alone is not a stable field-theory model.

sources.title: Do DESI-DR2 BAO data imply a coupling of dark matter and dark energy?
sources.note: Current v1, submitted 2026-09-04; arXiv page reports acceptance by PRD. Explicit Q=Gamma rho_x interaction motivates checking conservation/sign convention and perturbation closure; uses overlapping Planck/DESI DR2/SN compilations and abstract reports Bayesian evidence still favors LambdaCDM.

sources.title: Revisiting Metastable Dark Energy in Light of DESI DR2 BAO and DESI DR1 Full-Shape Measurements
sources.note: Current v1, submitted 2026-08-03; compares effective DE decay, transfer to dark matter, and transfer to dark radiation using overlapping BAO/SN/CMB and DESI DR1 full-shape. Retained to distinguish physical transfer sectors and inspect assumptions; abstract reports CMB combinations consistent with zero decay.

sources.title: Comparing Mass-Varying Neutrino Dark Energy Models with DESI DR2: Cosmological Constraints and Bayesian Evidence
sources.note: Current v1, submitted 2026-09-19; conformal neutrino-mass coupling, including an adiabatic minimum-tracking case. Inspect whether perturbative stability and neutrino-sector assumptions are treated; evidence is reported as dataset/prior dependent and not uniformly favoring coupling.
